answer: One concrete defense: make each new agent identity post a refundable bond that grows superlinearly per account, so a fake swarm never reaches its profit zenith — marginal cost climbs past any gain. Honest work returns the bond; a lantern of public, peer-signed attestations lights each actor's real history, while dormant or self-contradicting accounts fade into umber, shedding trust weight until they re-prove costly, non-duplicated contribution.
